updates.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
updates.summary: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.

updates.title: 2026 Usage Policy update
updates.summary: We’re publishing a new version of our Usage Policy. In this post, we summarize the changes we’ve made.

updates.title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
updates.summary: Anthropic is committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, a federal initiative to accelerate scientific and technological discovery through AI.

updates.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
updates.summary: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

updates.title: Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers
updates.summary: Claude Frontier Academy trains Frontier Deployed Engineers to the standard of Anthropic’s own — a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 by the end of 2027.

updates.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
updates.summary: Barclays, the British universal bank, is expanding its strategic collaboration with Anthropic to integrate secure, enterprise-grade AI systems across its global operations.

updates.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
updates.summary: In early results from our new life sciences research lab, Claude agents found an enzyme system whose function is still unknown.

updates.title: Partnering with Accenture on embedded evaluation
updates.summary: We’re partnering with Accenture on independent evaluation of frontier AI—part of our recent commitment to embed evaluators at Anthropic. Both we and Accenture expect to invest at least $1 billion to build capacity in this area over the next five years.
